browser.note: Nine end-to-end scenarios passed across the final verification runs, including a WebKit smoke check and 20 generate/cancel cycles. Mobile grid aspect ratio regression was fixed and retested.

geometry.note: 8 reference fixtures plus 3 boundary configurations; final mesh checked after 0.005 mm simplification.

cura.note: CuraEngine 5.13.0 CLI, generic QA settings, 8 fixtures. A harmless reset_flow_duration default warning is recorded. On the thin plate the topmost layer differs from PrusaSlicer; assembled fit remains untested.

physicalFit.note: External printed samples and reference-part fit checks have not been performed.

correspondingSource.note: Before distributing this preview publicly, archive corresponding source and build information for the exact prebuilt WASM engine and its compiled dependencies.
